name: ATMOSPHERE OS — MOBILE SCENT RESULTS
changes: Rebuilds mobile Scent Consultation results as a one-card horizontal swipe rail
Keeps the next recommendation slightly visible so the interaction is discoverable
Removes the duplicated profile percentage badge from consultation cards
Normalizes image, body and action geometry for readable mobile result cards
Adds an accessible swipe hint and keyboard-focusable recommendation region
Preserves desktop result layouts and all v16.0.4 account payment details
notes: The mobile override applies only at 680 px and below.
Catalog and product-page Scent Profile badges remain unchanged.
No checkout, payment, Supabase schema or order logic changed in this release.
